title: Magnetic Weight Nav
description: A vertical menu whose words get heavier and wider as the pointer or finger draws near.
problem: A static menu gives no hint which item you are about to choose.
interaction: Each word's weight and width track pointer or finger distance. The nearest word turns signal blue.

title: Hi-Vis After Dark
description: A headlamp in the dark. Retroreflective lettering stays dull grey until the beam lines up with your eye.

title: Hello WebGPU
description: A full-screen animated fragment shader running on WebGPU, with a WebGL2 fallback.
